simple-stamina.reason: The amber bolt itself forms the whole silhouette; the tablet and swirls are removed.

simple-damage.reason: A broad bright blade and red crossguard replace the small sword inset in a tablet.

simple-defense.reason: The blue shield is the object; its pointed perimeter and pale edge replace the stone backing.

template-wheat.reason: Three grain heads form a tied provisions bundle. The 16 px identity rests on the gold bundle contour; fine grain texture is not required.

template-fish.reason: Uses the wheat bundle composition with three silver-teal fish and one pale belly band. At 16 px it reads as a pale bundle more readily than a fish; at 32/40 the heads and tails read. This is a category-coherence tradeoff against the shipped single fish.

template-wood.reason: One cut log replaces the stack; the broad circular end separates timber from ore. Growth rings are secondary at 16 px.

template-hartwood.reason: Keeps the log outline and lighting with dark red bark and sap heart. Distinct from ordinary Wood, but darker than the shipped cut face at 16 px; its material contrast needs owner review.

template-stone.reason: One low rock mass with three major faces gives the ore category a broad horizontal contour.

template-coal.reason: Same rock contour as Stone, with charcoal material and cool grey planes. Separation is value-led rather than silhouette-led.

template-copper.reason: One warm trapezoid ingot replaces a pile. The broad oxide corner is the secondary material cue.

template-silver.reason: Exact ingot family in cool bright metal. Its brighter body separates it from Copper without a new composition.

template-ruby.reason: One upright prism distinguishes crystals from squat ore and horizontal ingots. Red is the resource hue slot.

template-true-ice.reason: Same prism in pale cyan with a broad frost stripe. The stripe matters at 32/40 px; hue and value dominate at 16 px.

template-ethereal-silica.reason: One green curved shard with a large opening forms the rare-fragment anchor, rather than a group of narrow needles.

template-dragonhide.reason: One red fallen scale follows the curved shard envelope. Its bright ridge is readable; the faceted material remains quite mineral-like.

template-fragment.reason: Amber curved artifact shard keeps the category envelope with a dark chipped edge. Less context than the shipped artifact; owner selection required.

template-essence.reason: One round vial contains a single pink drop; the short neck and round body separate reagents from open crystals.

template-research.reason: Same vial with teal liquid and a pale crystal. At 16 px the content relies mainly on hue; at 32/40 the crystal reads.

template-labor.reason: Centered human bust with one mallet. The larger face and broad shoulders establish the people template.

template-knight-t2.reason: Same bust framing as Labor, closed steel visor, maroon cloth and a sword. The human figure remains primary.

template-crossbowman-t2.reason: Same bust framing with visible face, steel kettle helmet, green clothing and a held crossbow. Weapon detail needs 32 px.
